clauses.uptime: Vendor guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime. If uptime falls below this threshold, customer is entitled to a 10% credit on their monthly bill.
clauses.maintenance_exclusion: Scheduled maintenance windows are excluded from uptime calculations only if notice is provided at least 72 hours in advance of the maintenance window.
clauses.claim_window: Customers must file claims within 30 days of the incident occurrence.
